title: A Rune Sits in the Same Group in Both Panes

steps.intent: start a new Claude tab, and in the Runes panel press New Rune Vault
in the Rune Library on the left, find two runes that sit in the Rune Satchel and turn both on
check the vault view on the right shows both runes under one Rune Satchel card, not split across cards named after where they came from
for each runeset the library lists, check the vault view puts its runes under a card with that same runeset name
